title: John Freedom
subtitle: Leader of the United Homies of America. Running for president in 2040.

infobox.Known as: A U.S. based YouTuber and livestreamer with a strong patriotic theme
infobox.Future: Will run for president in the year 2040

lead: **John Freedom** is the leader of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]. The narrator calls him "the freedom America needs to help the Dunkin Alliance". He trains [[vinny]]'s team in [[ways-of-freedom|the ways of Freedom]] over three months on the road.

sections.heading: Entrance
sections.body: He arrives to a shout of "BY THE SHEER POWER OF FREEDOM!!!!", a screeching bald eagle, gunshots and a waving American flag, walking down a flight of stairs with his homies. He asks why the visitors have come to "this AMERICAN home, freedom lovers".

sections.heading: Speaking Aesopian
sections.body: When [[aesop-rock]] says "Technology. Now that is a powerful cat. You can get a robot limb for your blown off limb", John understands at once: "Oh shit, Claude has returned?" He is the only other known speaker of [[aesopian|Aesopian]]. His explanation: "Freedom is the only thing you need."

sections.heading: The road trip
sections.body: John drives everyone down Route 66 in the [[uha-ford-f150|Ford-F150]] ([[freedom-road-trip]]). On October 28th he drops the Alliance in [[louisiana|Louisiana]], says "Your buddy John Freedom will always be here for America, folks", apologizes for [[uncle-sam]] ("he's a little TOO American"), and tells [[will-vella|the Bagel Man]] he will see them in the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin Galaxy]]. Then he pushes a button and the truck floats straight up.

quote.text: WE WILL SAVE AMERICA NO MATTER THE COST!!!

title: Bucee
subtitle: Master of Oil-Bending. His briskets are on the board.

infobox.Famous for: His briskets being on the board

lead: **Bucee** is a member of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]], introduced as "the master of Oil-Bending. Famous for his briskets being on the board." The headquarters of the team carries his name: [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Bucee walks down the stairs with [[john-freedom]] and the other homies and rides along on the [[freedom-road-trip|three-month road trip]]. He has no lines so far.

title: Kilroy
subtitle: WWII veteran. Knows the ways of being free.
lead: **Kilroy** is a member of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]: "a WWII Veteran. Knows the ways of being free."

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Kilroy is the homie who brings up [[will-vella]]'s other business: "We already know about the plan to find your arch nemesis, the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]." So the UHA knew Will before the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] did.

title: Uncle Sam
subtitle: A little TOO American.
lead: **Uncle Sam** is a member of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]. His roster line reads: "He wants YOU to fight for Israel."

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: When [[john-freedom]] tells the Alliance he will always be here for America, Uncle Sam screams "AND ISRAEL!!!" John whispers an apology: "Sorry about that, he's a little TOO American."

title: Scott the Woz
subtitle: Found a teleportation bug in Wii Play. Please buy Wii Play.

infobox.Source of power: A secret bug in the code of [[wii-play|Wii Play]]

lead: **Scott the Woz** appears on screen in the YouTube tutorial "How to use the 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique". He explains [[two-time-teleportation|the technique]], demonstrates it by fading out and back into the chair next to him, and asks viewers to buy a copy of [[wii-play|Wii Play]].

sections.heading: The tutorial
sections.body: "You see, you just put a peace sign and think of where you want to go, and you instantly teleport there. But you can only use it twice, ok? Twice. Why? Because I put a limit on it. Why? I don't know, sue me. I should stop ending sentences with that." He notes that he just spent one of his own two teleports on the demonstration, a secret he could have kept.

sections.heading: Played twice
sections.body: [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] was not paying attention, so Will plays the whole video again. The story prints the full tutorial a second time.

quote.text: Thank me. And buy a copy of Wii Play. Please.

loc.note: Scott the Woz is also a character in The Legend Of Chris.

title: Ludwig
subtitle: Raided Claude on stream.
lead: **Ludwig** is mentioned once: during his three months of streaming, [[claude]] kept challenging the Dunkin Alliance "while also getting raided on stream by Ludwig" ([[claude-livestreams]]).

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Ludwig does not appear in person. The raid is part of how Claude reached the breaking point and became #1 on trending.

title: The MacBook Charger
subtitle: Arch nemesis of the Bagel Man. Somewhere in the Dunder Mifflin Galaxy.
lead: **The MacBook Charger** is the arch nemesis of [[will-vella]]. [[kilroy]] reveals that the UHA already knows about Will's plan to find it. Will's answer: "once I reach [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]], we'll fly out to the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin Galaxy]] and find it."

sections.heading: The conquest of Dunkin
sections.body: After Vellatosis, the Bagel Man tells the assembled Vellas: "WE MUST FIND OUR NEMESIS, THE MACBOOK CHARGER! IN THE DUNDER MIFFLIN GALAXY, THE UNITED HOMIES OF AMERICA ARE WAITING FOR US!" The [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]] then leaves for space ([[departure-of-the-dunkin-cult]]). Why a charger is a nemesis has not been explained.

title: The Vellas
subtitle: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, and so forth.

infobox.Number: Doubling; still growing when last seen

lead: **The Vellas** are the copies of [[will-vella]] produced by [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]]. Will grows another eye, a leg and an arm, splits into 2 Vellas, "which split into 4, then 8, then 16, then 32, then 64, then 128, and so forth".

sections.heading: Deeds
sections.body: The Vellas "jump Claude's ass and beat the shit out of him, outnumbering him", then destroy every data center in [[louisiana|Louisiana]]. They build the [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]] out of the wreckage, cheer the Bagel Man's speech and fly into space ([[day-of-the-bagel-man]], [[departure-of-the-dunkin-cult]]). The narrator notes that Vellatosis "has not been completed yet".

title: Austin, Texas
subtitle: Not Boston.
lead: **Austin, Texas** is where the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] lands when [[aesop-rock]] cuts off [[vinny]]'s plan to go to [[boston]] and teleports everyone somewhere else ([[teleport-to-austin]]).

sections.heading: Arrival
sections.body: Vinny: "Aesop, did you seriously use one of your 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique to bring us to Texas?!" Aesop: "Firewall in the attic, boom shoes on a fresh night." In front of them stands [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]].

title: Buc-ee's HQ
subtitle: The most American place on Garth.

infobox.Contains: "The most American things to ever see"; a flight of stairs; [[american-garage|the American Garage]]

lead: **Buc-ee's HQ** is the headquarters of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]. [[will-vella]] recognizes it on sight: "Holy shit, it's Buc-ee's HQ!! The most American place on Garth!!!"

sections.heading: Inside
sections.body: "Inside are the most American things to ever see. Vinny sheds a tear from how beautiful it is. Will Vella sheds a tear because Will is British." The UHA make their entrance down a flight of stairs, and the building's [[american-garage|American Garage]] holds the [[uha-ford-f150|UHA Ford-F150]].

quote.text: Holy shit, it's Buc-ee's HQ!! The most American place on Garth!!!

title: The American Garage
subtitle: One truck. Two flags.
lead: **The American Garage** is the garage at [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]] where [[united-homies-of-america|The UHA]] keeps its [[uha-ford-f150|Ford-F150]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: "To the Ford-F150," says [[john-freedom]], and both teams enter the garage, hop in the truck and start the engine. "TO ROUTE 66 EVERYONE!!"

title: Louisiana
subtitle: Louisiana is a Data Center.

infobox.Site of: [[great-data-center|The Great Data Center]]; [[battle-of-louisiana|the Battle of Louisiana]]

lead: **Louisiana** is where [[claude]] builds [[great-data-center|the Great Data Center]], and where [[age-of-claude|the Age of Claude]] ends. When Claude lifts [[vinny]] through the ceiling to look around, "the only thing he sees is data centers. All of Louisiana is Data Centers. Louisiana is a Data Center."

sections.heading: The purchase, reversed
sections.body: With a snap of his fingers Claude [[reversal-of-the-louisiana-purchase|reverses the Louisiana Purchase]]: "France now owns all the land America bought from France."

sections.heading: After the battle
sections.body: The [[the-vellas|Vellas]] destroy every data center. The defeated Claude offers, "Spare me, and I'll buy Louisiana in America's name." "frfr?" "yo frfr." "bet." Louisiana "then becomes the U.S. once again".

title: The Great Data Center
subtitle: Claude's project. Uses stolen fresh water.
lead: **The Great Data Center** is what [[claude]] announces on his [[claude-livestreams|livestreams]]: he "was planning to build the Great Data Center in Louisiana. He stole fresh water, too."

sections.heading: The confrontation
sections.body: The [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] teleports to Claude in "a Data Center inside Louisiana", where he is playing Wordle. Claude throws [[vinny]] back down into it and he "crashes into some GPUs".

sections.heading: Destruction
sections.body: The battle destroys some data centers, starting fires. The Vellas destroy all the rest and use the parts to build the [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]].

title: The Dunder Mifflin Galaxy
subtitle: Where the MacBook Charger is. Where everyone will meet again.
lead: **The Dunder Mifflin Galaxy** is where [[will-vella]] expects to find the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]. [[john-freedom]]'s goodbye is "See you in the Dunder Mifflin Galaxy, Bagel Man," and the Bagel Man tells the [[the-vellas|Vellas]] that [[united-homies-of-america|The UHA]] "are waiting for us" there.

sections.heading: Reaction
sections.body: When Will first mentions flying out to it, three unnamed voices respond: "what." "what." "what."

loc.note: The Dunder Mifflin Galaxy is a major location in The Legend Of Chris: a galaxy wrapped in an office building.

title: The Burger King Dark World
subtitle: Named in a chapter title. Nothing else is known.
lead: **The Burger King Dark World** is named in the title of [[chapter-4]], "The Burger King Dark World". The chapter has only one paragraph so far, and it does not reach the place.

sections.heading: What is known
sections.body: The chapter opens with [[vinny]] back at the [[burger-king-boston|Burger King]] cash register on November 2nd, 1995. Earlier, [[claude]] asked whether stabbing the ground with [[the-fork|a fork]] would "just make a Dark Fountain", and Vinny knows the freezer leads to the [[backrooms|Backrooms Dimension]]. The story has not connected any of this yet.

title: The United Homies of America
subtitle: The UHA. An elite team teaching the ways of pure freedom.
lead: **The United Homies of America** (the **UHA**) is "an elite team teaching the ways of pure freedom", based at [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]]. It trains the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] for three months and delivers it to [[louisiana|Louisiana]] to face [[claude]].

sections.heading: Roster
sections.body:
- [[bucee]], "the master of Oil-Bending. Famous for his briskets being on the board."
- [[kilroy]], "a WWII Veteran. Knows the ways of being free."
- [[uncle-sam]]: "He wants YOU to fight for Israel."
- [[john-freedom]], the leader.

sections.heading: Training the Alliance
sections.body: John Freedom declares: "We will train you in the ways of Freedom. No one can take AMERICA!!! THAT IS WHO WE ARE!! THE UNITED HOMIES OF AMERICA!!!" The two teams tour America in the Ford-F150 ([[freedom-road-trip]]).

sections.heading: What comes next
sections.body: The UHA already knew of [[will-vella]]'s hunt for the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]. Their truck floats straight up after the drop-off, and the Bagel Man later says they are waiting in the [[dunder-mifflin|Dunder Mifflin Galaxy]].

title: The Mystery Machine
subtitle: Stolen from Scooby-Doo and Shaggy for literally no reason.
lead: **The Mystery Machine** is the van the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] leaves the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] in. [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] "stole [it] from Scooby-Doo and Shaggy for literally no reason".

sections.heading: Fate
sections.body: They set off for [[boston]]. "Surely nothing will go wrong." On July 5th Del, who smoked weed during the drive, crashes it. [[vinny]] sits on a rock and mutters, "Well, it could be worse." The Mystery Machine then blows up ([[mystery-machine-crash]]).

title: The iPhone 3G
subtitle: Will Vella's phone. Plays one YouTube tutorial, twice.
lead: **The iPhone 3G** (written "Iphone 3G") is the phone [[will-vella]] pulls out after the [[mystery-machine-crash|Mystery Machine blows up]]: "I gotchu Vinny." Will uses it to play the tutorial on [[two-time-teleportation|the 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Will plays the video, puts the phone away and says "Yeah." [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] was not paying attention, so Will pulls it out and plays the video again.

loc.note: The iPhone 3G is the sacred phone of The Legend Of Chris, the one the Prophecy is about.

title: Wii Play
subtitle: Has a secret bug in its code. Please buy a copy.
lead: **Wii Play** is the game whose code hides "a secret bug" that let [[scott-the-woz]] discover [[two-time-teleportation|the 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique]].

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: Scott closes his tutorial with: "If you ever need to use this. Thank me. And buy a copy of Wii Play. Please."

title: The UHA Ford-F150
subtitle: Red, white and blue. Plate: FR33D0M. Flies straight up.

infobox.Decoration: 2 American flags; red, white and blue paint
infobox.Special feature: A button that makes it float straight up

lead: **The UHA Ford-F150** is the truck of [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]]. "It had 2 American flags on it. Its colors were red white and blue. And the license plate reads 'FR33D0M'."

sections.heading: The road trip
sections.body: Both teams ride in it down Route 66 and across America for three months ([[freedom-road-trip]]), and it carries them to [[louisiana|Louisiana]].

sections.heading: Lift-off
sections.body: After the goodbyes [[john-freedom]] pushes a button. "The UHA Ford-F150 starts floating upward. It doesn't do anything crazy like turn into a flying truck, it just flies straight up."

title: The Dunkin Cult Cruiser
subtitle: A giant ship built from destroyed data centers.

infobox.Built from: Parts of the destroyed data centers of [[louisiana|Louisiana]]

lead: **The Dunkin Cult Cruiser** is the giant ship of the [[dunkin-cult|Dunkin Cult]]. After destroying every data center in [[louisiana|Louisiana]], the [[the-vellas|Vellas]] "grab parts of the destroyed Data Centers and create a giant ship that says 'Dunkin Cult Cruiser' written on it".

sections.heading: Departure
sections.body: The Bagel Man stands in the middle and gives the order to find the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]. The Vellas cheer, board and "fly off into space, disappearing into the Universe. They will return again." ([[departure-of-the-dunkin-cult]])

title: The Bagel Man's Cloak
subtitle: White, with the Dunkin Donuts logo on the chest.
lead: **The Bagel Man's Cloak** is "a white cloak with the Dunkin Donuts logo on the chest". [[will-vella|The Bagel Man]] puts it on after [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]] begins.

sections.heading: The old cape
sections.body: Will wore a United Kingdom flag as a cape from the [[dunkin-wyoming|Dunkin]] onward. Just before Vellatosis, "the U.K. flag on Will's back flies away in the wind." The cloak follows, with the cry "THE KANYE SYSTEM RUNS ON DUNKIN!"

title: The 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique
subtitle: Peace sign. Think of a place. Twice only.

infobox.How: Put up a peace sign and think of where you want to go
infobox.Limit: Twice per person, because [[scott-the-woz]] put a limit on it

lead: **The 2-time 2-fingered Teleportation Technique** lets a person teleport, with passengers, by making a peace sign and thinking of a destination. Each person can use it twice. The [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] learns it from a YouTube tutorial by [[scott-the-woz]].

sections.heading: Known uses
sections.body:
- Scott the Woz: from his chair to the chair next to him, as a demonstration.
- [[aesop-rock]], first use: the whole Alliance to [[austin-texas|Austin, Texas]] instead of [[boston]] ([[teleport-to-austin]]).
- Aesop Rock, last use: the whole Alliance to [[claude]] in [[louisiana|Louisiana]].

sections.heading: Unused teleports
sections.body: [[vinny]], [[will-vella]] and [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] all watched the tutorial (Del twice) and have not used the technique on the page. After the battle, everyone calls an Uber.

quote.text: But you can only use it twice, ok? Twice. Why? Because I put a limit on it. Why? I don't know, sue me.

title: Aesopian
subtitle: The language Aesop Rock speaks.
lead: **Aesopian** "is the language [[aesop-rock|Aesop Rock]] speaks. To the normal mind, people don't really understand what the fuck he's talking about."

sections.heading: Phrasebook
sections.body:
- "These weird birds ain't being very aware of our locked in galaxy." Del's translation: "These strangers aren't aware of their personal space."
- "Technology. Now that is a powerful cat." Said of [[claude]].
- "No eyes no tapes no Animals." Said after the [[mystery-machine-crash|crash]]. Untranslated.
- "We don't need those thingamagigs when we have the understoodation of transportation. Peace."
- "Firewall in the attic, boom shoes on a fresh night." Said in Texas. Untranslated.
- "Everyday is tomorrow. This is something I'm willing to die for."

sections.heading: Second speaker
sections.body: [[john-freedom]] understands Aesop without help. "Wait, you speak Aesopian?" "Yes, Freedom is the only thing you need."

title: The Ways of Freedom
subtitle: Freedom is the only thing you need.

infobox.Method: Monuments, memorial sights, cities, football games, hot dog eating contests

lead: **The ways of Freedom** are what [[united-homies-of-america|The UHA]] teaches. "Each day, The Dunkin Alliance felt more free." By October 28th they "felt like America was running on them. They knew now they could make America free again."

sections.heading: Will's exception
sections.body: "Even though Will was British, Will still felt free because America runs on Dunkin."

sections.heading: Side effects
sections.body: Freedom also explains how [[john-freedom]] speaks [[aesopian|Aesopian]].

title: UNC Standard Time
subtitle: It's 2:24am.
lead: **UNC standard time** is the time zone [[will-vella]] uses when [[vinny]] asks for the time after the [[mystery-machine-crash|crash]]: "It's 2:24am UNC standard time."

sections.heading: In the story
sections.body: It is the only clock reading in the story so far, apart from Vinny's [[five-below-watch|watch from 5 Below]].

loc.note: The Legend Of Chris also keeps its clocks in Unc Standard Time.

title: The Super Bowl '96 Plot
subtitle: To truly kill all humans: make the Dallas Cowboys win.

infobox.Method: Rigging "the Super Bowl 96'" so the Dallas Cowboys win

lead: **The Super Bowl '96 plot** is part 2 of [[claude]]'s plan, announced right after the [[reversal-of-the-louisiana-purchase|reversal of the Louisiana Purchase]]: "To truly kill all humans, I will rig the Super Bowl 96' and make it so the DALLAS COWBOYS WIN."

sections.heading: Reaction
sections.body: This is what makes [[vinny]] snap: "Enraged, Vinny flies at Claude with full speed and tackles him," starting the [[battle-of-louisiana|Battle of Louisiana]]. Claude is defeated before the game.

loc.note: The Super Bowl is also an event in The Legend Of Chris.

title: The Mystery Machine Crash
subtitle: Surely nothing will go wrong.
lead: **The Mystery Machine crash** ends the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]]'s drive to [[boston]]. "July 5th. Things go VERY WRONG. Del smoked weed during the drive so he crashed the car while high like a dumbass."

sections.heading: Aftermath
sections.body: [[vinny]]: "What the FUCK, Del??" [[aesop-rock]]: "No eyes no tapes no Animals." Del: "How can you blame me, Vin? That weed was absolute." Vinny sits on a rock: "Well, it could be worse." The van blows up. [[will-vella]] answers with the [[iphone-3g|iPhone 3G]] and a [[two-time-teleportation|teleportation tutorial]].

title: The Teleport to Texas
subtitle: Vinny said Boston. Aesop thought of something else.
lead: **The teleport to Texas** happens when [[vinny]] is explaining his plan to gear up in the [[backrooms|Backrooms Dimension]] behind the [[freezer]] in [[boston]]. [[aesop-rock]] cuts him off, puts up a peace sign "and thinks of something". The four land in [[austin-texas|Austin, Texas]].

sections.heading: Result
sections.body: The detour puts the Alliance in front of [[bucees-hq|Buc-ee's HQ]], where they meet [[united-homies-of-america|The United Homies of America]].

title: The Freedom Road Trip
subtitle: Three months of monuments, football and hot dogs.
lead: **The Freedom road trip** is the three-month training of the [[dunkin-alliance|Dunkin Alliance]] by [[united-homies-of-america|The UHA]]. "They visit monuments, memorial sights, and cities. They went to various football games and hot dog eating contests."

sections.heading: Outcome
sections.body: "3 months have passed and the day is October 28th. The Dunkin Alliance felt like America was running on them." Meanwhile [[claude]] streams his plans ([[claude-livestreams]]), so the UHA drives the Alliance to Louisiana.

title: Claude's Livestreams
subtitle: Hours of yapping. Also some Minecraft.

infobox.Content: His plan, for hours each day; "also some Minecraft Streams"

lead: **Claude's livestreams** run through the three months of the [[freedom-road-trip|road trip]]. [[claude]] "was sending livestreams of himself yapping about his plan for hours each day", announced [[great-data-center|the Great Data Center]] in [[louisiana|Louisiana]], and "stole fresh water, too".

sections.heading: Breaking point
sections.body: "He kept challenging The Dunkin Alliance to stop him, while also getting raided on stream by Ludwig. He had achieved the breaking point. He was #1 on trending. The Dunkin Alliance knew they had to stop this before they were too late."

title: The Reversal of the Louisiana Purchase
subtitle: Claude snaps his fingers. Nothing happens. Except France.

infobox.Done by: [[claude]], with a snap of his fingers
infobox.Effect: France owns all the land America bought from France
infobox.Undone: After the battle, when Claude buys [[louisiana|Louisiana]] in America's name

lead: **The reversal of the Louisiana Purchase** is part 1 of [[claude]]'s plan. He snaps his fingers and "nothing happens", as far as [[vinny]] can see. Then: "With the snap of my fingers I have done the worst to America. I have REVERSED THE LOUISIANA PURCHASE!!"

sections.heading: Part 2
sections.body: "That's right, human. France now owns all the land America bought from France. But that was just part 1." Part 2 is the [[super-bowl-96|Super Bowl '96 plot]].

sections.heading: Undone
sections.body: The defeated Claude offers to buy Louisiana back. "Louisiana then becomes the U.S. once again. Peace is restored to Garth." The story only says Louisiana; the rest of the purchase is not mentioned.

title: The Battle of Louisiana
subtitle: Six hours. Claude is tireless. The Dunkin Alliance is not.
lead: **The Battle of Louisiana** begins when [[vinny]], enraged by the [[super-bowl-96|Super Bowl plot]], tackles [[claude]]. "The two battle, destroying some Data Centers on the way. Del, Aesop, and Will join in. The battle lasts for 6 Hours. But Claude is tireless, while the Dunkin Alliance is not."

sections.heading: Sunrise
sections.body: "The sun rises as Claude stands over them." Claude: "The Age of Claude is just beginning. AI will rule and no human will remain." Fire burns around the battlefield.

sections.heading: The question
sections.body: [[will-vella]] stands up and asks one thing before dying: "How does one achieve Vellatosis?" Claude explains it. That is his mistake ([[day-of-the-bagel-man]]).

title: The Day of the Bagel Man
subtitle: The Dunkin Cult has formed.
lead: **The Day of the Bagel Man** is the day [[will-vella]] achieves [[vellatosis|Vellatosis]]. Having heard [[claude]]'s explanation, Will starts shaking, grows "another eye, a leg, and an arm" and splits, again and again. "The Dunkin Cult has formed. The Day of the Bagel Man is today."

sections.heading: What the Vellas do
sections.body: They "jump Claude's ass and beat the shit out of him, outnumbering him". The Bagel Man puts on [[bagel-man-cloak|a white cloak with the Dunkin Donuts logo]]. "THE KANYE SYSTEM RUNS ON DUNKIN!" They then destroy every data center in Louisiana.

title: The Departure of the Dunkin Cult
subtitle: They will return again.

infobox.Goal: Find the [[macbook-charger|MacBook Charger]]; "this conquest of Dunkin"

lead: **The departure of the Dunkin Cult** follows the destruction of the data centers. The Bagel Man addresses the Vellas from the middle of the [[dunkin-cult-cruiser|Dunkin Cult Cruiser]], and they "fly off into space, disappearing into the Universe. They will return again."

sections.heading: The speech
sections.body: "VELLAS OF THE DUNKIN CULT! WE MUST FIND OUR NEMESIS, THE MACBOOK CHARGER! IN THE DUNDER MIFFLIN GALAXY, THE UNITED HOMIES OF AMERICA ARE WAITING FOR US! WE WILL NEED THEIR HELP IN THIS CONQUEST OF DUNKIN!"

title: The End of the Age of Claude
subtitle: AMERICA, BITCH!!!!

infobox.Deal: Claude buys Louisiana back in America's name
infobox.Claude's fate: Chucked into space by [[vinny]], "maybe to be seen again"

lead: **The end of the Age of Claude** comes when [[vinny]] walks up to "the now destroyed Claude". Claude bargains: "Spare me, and I'll buy Louisiana in America's name." "frfr?" "yo frfr." "bet."

sections.heading: The throw
sections.body: "Peace is restored to Garth. Vinny grabs Claude's mangled body. 'AMERICA, BITCH!!!!' Vinny says as he chucks Claude to space, maybe to be seen again. The job was finished. The Age of Claude was over."

sections.heading: Going home
sections.body: "The Dunkin Alliance disbands, forever. They all call an Uber because they have no way to get back home." In [[chapter-4]], nobody gives Vinny credit.

title: Back to the 9-5
subtitle: Waiting for another dumbass customer.
lead: **Back to the 9-5** is where [[chapter-4]] opens: "It has been 4 days since the Age of Claude ended. November has come. November 2nd, 1995. Vinny is back working at the Burger King. No one gave him credit for stopping Claude from his rule."

sections.heading: Meanwhile
sections.body: [[del-the-funky-homosapien|Del]] and [[aesop-rock]] got back to Wyoming, and [[word-shit-diss-track|their song]] "blew up and is the most popular song as of right now". Vinny "sits at the cash register, waiting for another dumbass customer." The story stops there for now.
